rationale: The original thesis relied on price remaining suppressed beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA and session VWAP to drive a breakdown toward session lows. After 25 minutes in the trade, price has failed to break down and instead reclaimed both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($25.85) and session VWAP ($25.94), negating the bearish consolidation setup. Exiting now preserves capital ahead of the $26.02 hard invalidation level.
